Damian Frederick Holland, or better known by his penname, as Malcolm Moreau, is a [[Human|theriform human]] science fiction writer and comic book artist. He is best known for his 10-book series entitled ''The Microcontinents: A Natural History''.

== Early Life ==
Damian was born on January 17, 2086, in Washington County, Oregon. As a theriform human, he had the physical characteristics, and abilities of the animal donor parent. In Damian's case, it was an emu, which made him a fast runner, and agile. Making any attempt at catching him a near impossible task. His emu DNA also gave Damian a shaggy appearance, which was often a source of ridicule. He was also known for having a relatively deep voice compared to the other kids.

At age 17, he became interested in speculative biology after acquiring copies of ''The World of Kong: A Natural History of Skull Island'' by Weta Workshop and ''After Man: A Zoology Of The Future ''by Dougal Dixon, as well as becoming an active member of the ''Speculative Evolution'' internet forum under the username Shagrat86. Despite the books' scientific inaccuracies regarding the wildlife, it sowed the seeds in his mind, the blueprints of what would become his life's work. During his writing class, he presented a rough draft of a story that he described as, "an example of how not to write a hollow earth story." Despite his lack of confidence in the draft, it was well-received by most of his classmates.

He graduated from Jefferson Online College with a modified diploma and received a PhD in Linguistics on June 14, 2110.

== Natural Histories ==
Holland's most famous work by far is ''[[The Microcontinents: A Natural History]],'' a 10-book series describing hypothetical ecosystems that may have existed in Earth's distant past on landmasses that have since disappeared underwater. Each book in the series was styled as a "field guide" to a different prehistoric landmass at a different time. The series currently contains ten books.

The books included the following:

''Tropical Antarctica ''(Antarctica, 150 million years ago)

''Edge of the World'' (Kerguelen Plateau, 75 million years ago)

''Sundaland (''Indonesia, 2 million years ago)

''The Great Island ''(Maui Nui, Hawaii, 1 million years ago)

''Shell, Feather, and Bone ''(Zealandia, 35 million years ago)

== Comics ==

== Physical Appearance ==
As mentioned above, Damien is a genetic chimera of a human and an emu, with the balance being human. While he has a human's general body plan, the lower portions of his legs are elongated, and heavily muscled. Each foot is digitigrade in structure and bore three, long toes, with the middle toe being longer than the other toes. The structure of his feet meant that if he was in a tough situation, he could outrun his aggressors, or strike them down with his bone-cracking kicks. His arms were normal human arms, but with feather quills lining his elbows, and ended at the wrists.

A '''vactrain''' (or '''vacuum tube train''') is a mode of very-high speed rail transportation. It is a maglev (magnetic levitation) line using partly evacuated tubes or tunnels. Reduced air resistance could permit vactrains to travel at very high (hypersonic) speeds with relatively little power—up to 6,400–8,000 km/h (4,000–5,000 mph). This is 5–6 times the speed of sound in Earth's atmosphere at sea level.

== History ==
===Early history===
With the successful human passenger test by Virgin Hyperloop in 2020, and its inclusion in the bipartisan infrastructure bill in 2021, it was only the matter of time before hyperloop truly become a reality. Most hyperloop companies went bankrupt prior to the [[Market Crash of 2027]].

===Development===
Vactrain development slowed considerably after the 2020s after investor capital contracted and government support to high-speed rail grew. After the development of room temperature superconductors and the emergence of the first [[Android]]s, development and operating costs fell considerably, and a new generation of startups emerged in the 2060s and 70s to build the first commercial vactrain tracks in Illinois, Texas, and California. Government regulations and high capital costs limited these tracts to be single-state lines.

The economic policies of the [[Oscar Lachman|Lachman]] administration saw private vactrain lines expand exponentially, eventually replacing traditional high speed rail. This enabled anyone in the US to travel to anywhere else in the continental US in 30 minutes or less, and after connecting lines were built between the US and Mexico, anywhere on the continent. From here vactrain projects spread worldwide in a high decentralized network, with most governments only administering switching stations and ticketing infrastructure.

The vactrain network served as a major redistributor of wealth from urban areas to rural communities, and made it much easier to manage the new workforce. Rural regions grew in wealth as urban workers would relocate to buy cheap land and create high density residential developments for citizens commuting to major cities and back. The hyperloop network would be a driving force behind the [[Quantum Capacitor|Quantum Boom of the 2090s]], as it made it easier for businesses to expand or be created on cheap land while still efficiently reaching customers and investors.

===Nationalization===
During the [[Lionel Halvidar]] administration, the US government nationalized most private vactrains on Earth and largely absorbed control of many damaged or bankrupt international networks to create a global vactrain network.
